extraction.notes: Quarter ended June 30, 2025 column. Starts from Net income and reconciles to 'FFO available to Common Shares and Units' (382,633), the first FFO subtotal in the table; a separate 'FFO' line of 382,988 (before preferred distributions) is printed on the same page but not used as ffo_total. Normalized FFO available to Common Shares and Units = 386,790 is the core total. Diluted share count 391,498 reproduces $0.98 FFO and $0.99 Normalized FFO per share. No AFFO metric is reported, so affo fields are null. Recurring capex is disclosed on page 26 (seq 31) only for the six months ended June 30, 2025 ($81,855 thousand, Recurring Capital Expenditures), not for the quarter, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Zero-amount line 'Debt extinguishment and preferred share redemption (gains) losses' shown as '—' for Q2 2025 was recorded as 0.
